annotations.title: Studio: hear a voice say a sentence

description: Free voice test: a voice from studio_listar_vozes (or the user’s own minha-<id>) says a short sentence the user chooses (up to 120 characters; a few tests per day). Returns a one-hour link to the audio to show the user. Use it when the user wants to hear how a voice sounds with their own words before choosing or before a render. Free.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.

texto.description: The sentence to say (up to 120 characters). Empty = a standard greeting.
